package domain

import "time"

const (
	LessonExampleStatusInactive = 0
	LessonExampleStatusActive   = 1
)

// LessonExample is a first-class instructional artifact attached to a lesson.
type LessonExample struct {
	ID              string              `json:"id"`
	SourceKey       string              `json:"source_key"`
	LessonID        string              `json:"lesson_id"`
	LessonSourceKey string              `json:"lesson_source_key"`
	Order           int                 `json:"order"`
	Status          int                 `json:"status"`
	Mode            string              `json:"mode"`
	PrimaryStack    *string             `json:"primary_stack,omitempty"`
	Stacks          []string            `json:"stacks"`
	TargetConcepts  []string            `json:"target_concepts"`
	Translations    []LessonExampleI18n `json:"translations"`
	CreatedAt       time.Time           `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt       time.Time           `json:"updated_at"`
}

// LessonExampleI18n stores localized example title and Markdown body.
type LessonExampleI18n struct {
	ExampleID   string `json:"example_id"`
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Language    string `json:"lang"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

// LessonExampleRelation is a directed semantic edge between examples.
type LessonExampleRelation struct {
	ID                     string    `json:"id"`
	SourceKey              string    `json:"source_key"`
	SourceExampleID        string    `json:"source_example_id"`
	SourceExampleSourceKey string    `json:"source_example_key"`
	TargetExampleID        string    `json:"target_example_id"`
	TargetExampleSourceKey string    `json:"target_example_key"`
	Relation               string    `json:"relation"`
	PrimaryStack           string    `json:"primary_stack"`
	Stacks                 []string  `json:"stacks"`
	Concepts               []string  `json:"concepts"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt              time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}
